review:
The tenth Big Bass, on six Megaways reels with up to 147,456 ways and cascades. Mystery symbols can land and all reveal the same symbol.

Two bonuses: free spins with the usual multiplier system – now with unlimited retriggers – and a hold-and-spin with three respins to land cash prizes, each new prize resetting the count. Megaways plus cascades make it one of the swingiest-feeling Big Bass games. Up to 20,000x, 96.7% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
